name: Krea 2 Turbo — QuadView character turnaround (4 panels)
description:
Upload a picture of a character and get back one landscape image (1536x1024) split into four panels of that same character: a face close-up, a front full-body view, a side full-body view and a back full-body view. It's a quick turnaround sheet for concept art, 3D-modelling reference, or keeping a character consistent across other images.

The instruction box is pre-filled with the sentence the QuadView LoRA was trained on — you can add details ("in a watercolour style", "wearing a red scarf"), but keep the core sentence. 'Likeness strength' controls how hard the model copies your picture: 1 is the normal setting, 3–4 gives a closer match of face and clothing, and much higher values make the result stiff. 'Steps': around 8 sticks more strictly to the four-panel layout, 12 adds face detail, 10 is a good balance. A single sheet takes well under a minute.
author: conradlocke / comfyui-krea2edit (QuadView LoRA)
